01 / Position

Knowledge base as raw-material supplier.
We don't generate.

Users don't talk to the knowledge base directly. Other agents — OpenClaw / Lark AI / DingTalk AI / Claude / your in-house bot — call us via MCP / CLI / REST and get retrieval snippets, structured material, and file links.

Generation — marketing copy, planning docs, posters — stays with the calling agent. File originals stay on your local server, never leaving the perimeter.

This is an anti-SaaS choice. We don't sell a generic chatbox or compete for user attention. Our customer is the enterprise, not the consumer.

02 / Three capabilities

Decompose · Retrieve · Ground

MVP is exactly these three. We make them industrial before chasing scope.
01 / DECOMPOSE

Decompose

Compound questions become atomic sub-queries.

"What interfaces does X support, which chip, any compat issues?" hides at least three retrieval intents: protocol match / component listing / conflict graph. Each routes to its own path, then aggregates.

query_expander.py · solution_reflect SHIPPED
02 / RETRIEVE

Retrieve

Hybrid retrieval: vector store + knowledge graph + full-text.

RRF fusion, MMR diversity, BGE Reranker for final ordering. Intent-routed: quick / standard / deep — no wasted compute, no missed recall.

hybrid_retriever.py · Qdrant · Neo4j SHIPPED
03 / GROUND

Ground

Dedup, conflict-flag, confidence-score — assemble into structured material.

Calling agent receives {facts: [...], citations: [...], confidence: 0.87, gaps: [...]} — not a wall of text. Every fact carries a source. When unsure, we say so explicitly.

solution_synthesis · grounded RAG IN POLISH
03 / Core constraint

Industrial-grade grounded RAG.
Zero tolerance for hallucination.

Will support industrial production decisions. That's decision-support liability, not a chat toy.
Must do
✓

100% citation

Every sentence has a source. No source = no statement.

✓

Forced transparency

If we don't know, we say "insufficient information — add docs of type X".

✓

Confidence labels

For near-misses we surface the score: "related, not exact, confidence 0.62".

Must not
✗

Fabricate numbers

Numbers from the model's training corpus for "similar" products are not this product's numbers. No invention.

✗

Confuse products

Reporting product A's spec as product B's. In hardware that's an incident-level error.

✗

Misread the source

Cite the right doc, get the meaning wrong. The most dangerous form — the citation looks valid.

04 / Integration

Three protocols.
Picked by real scenarios.

A · MCP STDIO

MCP Protocol

Primary path. Claude Code, Hermes Agent, other MCP-aware tools plug in directly. 313/319 stdio integration tests passing.

// 4 tools exposed
kg_search(query, top_k)
kg_graph_query(cypher)
kg_board_query(board_id)
kg_add_feedback(qid, score)
B · CLI

Command line

Calling agent doesn't speak MCP? Use CLI — subprocess stdin/stdout, language-agnostic. OpenCLI adapter ready.

$ shiguang search "main board interface list"
→ facts: [3], citations: [3],
   confidence: 0.91
C · REST API

REST API

05 / Knowledge graph schema

8 node types.
5 core relationships.

Current schema serves hardware manufacturing (validated at a rail-transit equipment client). Multi-tenant version evolves with new clients.
NODE
Product
Product aggregator. Multiple Boards compose a Product.
NODE
Board
Board — primary query subject. Carries parameters_json and full-text index.
NODE
Component
Physical component. Chips, passives, connectors, electromechanical parts.
NODE
Parameter
Parameter definition: name + value + unit. Attached to Board or Component.
NODE
Document
Document metadata. file_hash unique constraint prevents duplicates.
NODE
SchematicComponent
Schematic-extracted component. Parsed by Gemini 2.5.
REL
CONTAINS_COMPONENT
Product / Board → Component (with quantity)
REL
COMPATIBLE_WITH · REPLACES · CONFLICTS_WITH
Component → Component. Powers BOM selection and substitute analysis.
